certificationNotice: Standards-aligned baseline only; this is not formal ISO, IEC, ISA, safety, cybersecurity, or regulatory certification.

Stage1ImageValidation.description: PoC image validation and client demo evidence. Simulated hardware may be disclosed but cannot satisfy real hardware gates.

FullFactoryAutomation.description: Full factory automation and production-like release.

gates.requirement: Operator screens support 1920x1080 minimum layout, 14 pt readable text, 120x40 px primary buttons, high contrast, no clipped critical status, and DPI/resize tolerance.
gates.evidenceRequired: Layout stress report, UI smoke evidence, screenshots, or manual signoff covering resolution, font, button, scroll, resize, and DPI rules.

gates.requirement: Dense pages use ScrollViewer or adaptive layout so reports, settings, queues, and dashboards remain reachable at 1920x1080 and 100/125/150% DPI.
gates.evidenceRequired: Automated HMI layout audit covering major WPF pages and required controls, including dense-page ScrollViewer checks.

gates.requirement: Alarms and warnings are readable, prioritized, timestamped, recoverable, and not hidden or clipped.
gates.evidenceRequired: Alarm/event UI evidence and audit/event export evidence.

gates.requirement: No active Critical alarm may remain unresolved for client-demo, pilot, release, or factory-readiness packaging.
gates.evidenceRequired: Alarm/event service evidence showing zero active Critical alarms and auditability for acknowledgements.

gates.requirement: Inspection visualization targets 1 second or less and records timing evidence.
gates.evidenceRequired: Benchmark or latency report with p95 timing and over-1-second count.

gates.requirement: Menu/page navigation uses cached construction and async refresh so major page switching does not freeze the UI thread or crash constructors.
gates.evidenceRequired: Navigation smoke/performance report with page switch timings, constructor crash coverage, and slow-load warnings.

gates.requirement: No current uninvestigated crash report and stability evidence appropriate to deployment stage.
gates.evidenceRequired: Crash summary plus UI stability or soak report.

gates.requirement: Global WPF, AppDomain, and unobserved-task exception containment writes crash reports and shows recoverable operator-safe errors instead of raw stack traces.
gates.evidenceRequired: Crash containment tests plus CrashReportService evidence for dispatcher, domain, and unobserved task paths.

gates.requirement: Production-relevant actions are auditable and secrets are redacted from evidence.
gates.evidenceRequired: Authentication, role authorization, secret redaction, and audit export evidence.

gates.requirement: Code quality scripts block empty catches, non-event async void, UI-thread blocking, heavy UI file IO, raw exception stack traces, hard-coded secrets, and simulated-hardware overclaims.
gates.evidenceRequired: Passing code-quality report and PR quality report artifacts.

gates.requirement: CSV, PNG, PDF, JSON, HTML, TXT, and package exports used as evidence are verified for existence, parseability/signature where practical, checksum, and required fields.
gates.evidenceRequired: Export verification records with OK status and checksums.

gates.requirement: Real camera, lighting, 3D profile, robot, and safety evidence is present when the deployment profile requires real hardware.
gates.evidenceRequired: Real hardware acceptance runs. Simulation evidence must be labeled and cannot satisfy this gate.

gates.requirement: Simulated, mock, null, or boundary-only camera/robot/lighting/MES evidence must never be presented as production-ready or real-hardware-ready evidence.
gates.evidenceRequired: Code-quality/PR quality evidence plus runtime readiness labels showing simulation and real-hardware boundaries.

gates.requirement: MES or central sync evidence includes payload mapping, queue/retry behavior, endpoint mode, redaction, and signoff status when the profile requires MES evidence.
gates.evidenceRequired: Traceability signoff, MES queue/export report, or central sync queue/readiness report.

gates.requirement: Release package includes build, test, publish validation, gate report, and verified package evidence.
gates.evidenceRequired: Build/test evidence and package manifest/export verification.

gates.requirement: Build/test evidence is present; missing evidence is WARN for Stage 1 and FAIL for factory/production profiles.
gates.evidenceRequired: Release build/test evidence with restore, build, test, and publish validation status.
